finalists.label: Tubo-ovarian abscess
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including a cystic mass with purulent fluid, and is not contradicted by the normal appearance of the appendix.

finalists.label: Ovarian cyst
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including a cystic mass, but lacks evidence of infection.

finalists.label: Ectopic pregnancy
finalists.why: It is ruled out by the negative urine human chorionic gonadotropin test.

finalists.label: Pelvic inflammatory disease due to HIV-negative status
finalists.why: It lacks any for or against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of purulent fluid in the cystic mass decides the final comparison in favor of Tubo-ovarian abscess.
